observed: Six monitor-crowned posts fill a cutaway floor; dense rings of traders surround the counters and spill into the aisles.
Raised arms, order slips, paper planes and scattered papers make the crowd read as a session in progress.
The back wall carries token screens, a bell and podium; whiteboards and a file-room opening occupy the right side, with an elevator landing on the left.
Warm timber flooring sits beneath dark monitor housings and varied jackets.
corrections: Keep the composition and crowd density, but derive dimensions and station counts in the proportions round rather than tracing this image as geometry.
Do not carry over faint facial features, decorative brass, orange accents or the formal turned-baluster rails.
Token screens need only an emblem and one brass price line with a faint scale; generated coloured emblems are not a picked palette.
Use the actual orthographic camera, flat four-tone materials and quieter floor-joint lines instead of the image's texture and soft shading.

Colour audit 13 October: lift dark glass and deep jacket faces for near-black outlines at 3:1; separate brass-like jacket colours; replace white price lines with brass and remove decorative gold on rails or bell supports.
